preconditions.description: The number of integers n must be between 1 and 32768.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i < 32768 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer a_i in the list must be between 0 and 32767.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each output integer must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == min_operations(a[i]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output integer must represent the minimum number of operations required to make the corresponding a_i equal to 0.
